abstract: From 1958 to 1974, 129 patients with pure seminoma of the testis were admitted to the Institute of Radiology, University of Florence. Sixty-two were in Stage I, 36 in Stage II A, 23 in Stage II B, 3 in Stage III, and 5 in Stage IV, Para-aortic and ipsilateral iliac nodes were treated in all cases with doses ranging from 3000 to 4200 rads. In the treatment of the supradiaphragmatic area, uniform criteria were not adopted. Out of 124 cases in Stage I, II A and B, and III, 17 suffered a replase; aall relapsed cases died except for one. Site and cause of the failures were analyzed. Prophylactic irradiation of the mediastinum and supraclavicular area appears to lower the probability of recurrence in Stage II. Doses over 3500 rads may be necessary to destroy large metastases. The presence of nonseminomatous areas in the seminoma showing inadequate regression after radiotherapy must be suspected; an exploratory laparotomy should be indicated in such a case.
abstract_ja: 1958年から1974年の間に、フィレンツェ大学放射線医学研究所に純粋精巣セミノーマの患者129例が入院した。病期Iが62例、病期IIAが36例、病期IIBが23例、病期IIIが3例、病期IVが5例であった。病期I、IIA、IIB、IIIの124例において傍大動脈および同側腸骨リンパ節に3000〜4200 radの照射を行った。124例中17例が再発し、再発例はほぼ全例が死亡した。縦隔と鎖骨上窩への予防的照射は、病期IIでの再発を減少させるようであった。大きな転移の制御には3500 rad超の線量が必要となる可能性がある。放射線療法後に退縮が不十分な非セミノーマ性成分が疑われる場合は、開腹による探索的手術を行うべきであると考えられた。
